author: Vox
description:
Clothing brands rely on influencers to drive internet trends and sell more clothes. Meghan Russell, founder of Detoure, a Los Angeles second-hand shop filled with influencers’ clothes, says some content creators will drop off around 10 bags of clothes a month. 

“Because when your job is to post a new outfit every single day, you just acquire so much clothing.” 

What has this cycle done to the market and our sense of personal style? And could second-hand stores be the answer to AI fashion slop?
